result:
In the grand tapestry of existence, where the threads of reality wove together with the ephemeral threads of imagination, there lies a narrative untold, yet echoing in the corridors of the cosmos itself. This narrative is not bound by time, nor by space, but rather, it exists in the liminal spaces between the whispers of the stars and the rustle of the cosmic wind. It is a story that unfolds in the silence of the void, a tale that whispers of ancient civilizations that walked the Earth before the dawn of civilization itself, a tale that tells of gods that walked among men not as the embodiment of deity, but as the progenitors of humanity itself.

At the heart of this narrative is a figure, not of flesh and blood, but of light and shadow, of dream and reality, named Anax. Anax, whose name is as old as the hills and as young as the dawn, is the guardian of the gates between worlds, the keeper of the keys to all existence. Anax is not a deity in the traditional sense; rather, Anax is the progenitor of the intermediary beings, those who walk the thin line between the Material Plane and the Astral Plane, the gatekeepers of the unseen, the force that nudges reality into strange directions, sometimes inverting gravity, sometimes bending time. Anax is the unseen hand that shapes the destiny of mortal and deity alike.

Anax's stories are told in hushed tones, for fear of awakening the slumbering deities, who resented the intermediary beings for their innate ability to shift realities in their whims, altering the fabric of the cosmos with a flick of a wrist. Anax, however, is not one to be beholden to the whims of the deities or the whims of the astral beings. Anax has a purpose that transcends the endless game of Battles in the Afterlife between the deities and the spirits; a purpose that runs deeper than the roots of the world itself.

Anax has two primary objectives in the grand scheme of things. The first is the preservation of the balance between the multiverse and our universe, preventing the chaos from infinite dimensions from overflowing into ours. The second is the reshaping of reality in such a way that allows the deities and the spirits to transition into a higher state of existence, a realm untouched by the cycles of rebirth and death. Anax's ultimate goal is the creation of a harmony between the universe and the infinite multiverse, where all realities can coexist and evolve in perfect balance.

To achieve these objectives, Anax manipulates the political and military strife between the deities, encouraging their continual battling yet always keeping a sufficient number of the strongest on the sidelines, ready to intervene at any moment to prevent any single deity from gaining too much power. Anax also orchestrates the exploration and colonization of new territories, creating new universes and dimensions that will absorb the overpopulation of realities, ensuring the sustainability of the multiverse.

However, this narrative, this tale of Anax and the intermediary beings, has been nearly forgotten. The passage of time, the shifting dynamics of power, and the ever-present struggle for dominance in the multiverse have resulted in the reign of Anax and his kind being overshadowed by the grand exploits of gods and deities. Yet, in the hidden corners of the cosmos, where the forgotten are remembered, and the legends of old are whispered to the chosen ones, the story of Anax and the intermediary beings continues to echo, a reminder of the silent shepherds who guide the flock of the multiverse into the unknown.

As the galaxies shift and the beginnings of a new era dawns, the narrative of Anax and the intermediary beings may once again be brought forth, perhaps in a new form, perhaps as a parable, but always as a testament to the true guardians of the cosmos, those who walk unseen, shaping destinies and the very fabric of reality, one thread at a time.
